scope: Independent read-only WPF window-lifecycle source review. Renderer reports a successful Release cross-build; this audit did not run Windows or execute the WPF UI.

checks.finding: 空闲时取消/返回按钮可用并调用Close；忙碌时明确取消当前操作，已请求取消时防止重复操作。
X和Escape覆盖关闭/取消入口；Closed先标记closed并递增epoch，再请求异步取消。
安装、回退和离线导入使用applyCommittedResult:true；后台已正常返回实际UpdateStatus时，即使随后请求取消，也应用已提交状态，不伪装成未安装。check/status仍拒绝取消后的结果。
worker只返回UI Action；await回到Dispatcher后，先检查closed和operationEpoch，再执行UI更新。
进度排队和执行时检查关闭、epoch、busy及取消状态，不覆盖关闭或取消后的UI。
CancelAsync回调完成后释放本次CTS；只清除同一work引用。关闭期间不抢先Dispose仍在使用的UpdateService，待worker收尾后释放。
重复打开复用一个owned UpdateWindow；更新窗ShowInTaskbar=false且ResizeMode.NoResize，避免额外任务栏按钮和可操作的最小化/最大化框。
记录打开前的非Minimized状态；关闭后恢复保存状态并激活主窗，不强制改为Normal，因此保留原Maximized。
Closed验证实例身份；恢复操作在排队前及ContextIdle执行时双检generation和当前updateWindow为空。新窗口使旧恢复回调失效。
Closing早于Closed记录退出意图，恢复路径同时拒绝closing、closed及Dispatcher shutdown，避免owned窗口关闭时复活主窗。
compactMode阻止关闭更新窗的恢复回调强行展开主窗；展开时只在Minimized状态恢复最近非最小化状态。
截图时显式隐藏当前可见更新窗；finally仅恢复同一实例且不激活。关闭更新窗的恢复请求在captureBusy时延后，收尾后再做generation检查。

rootCauseEvidence.idleButton: 0.4.0 Controls explicitly used cancel.IsEnabled=busy; idle cancellation had no close behaviour.
rootCauseEvidence.ownerMinimized: No explicit minimize instruction was found in 0.4.0. The exact Windows native focus/ownership cause was not reproduced on Linux. 0.4.1 explicitly restores prior owner state and constrains owned-window lifecycle.

runtimeAcceptanceStillRequired: Windows: open from Maximized and Normal main windows, then close using X and idle return; confirm prior state and focus.
Windows: reopen updates immediately after closing; confirm one window and no delayed owner-focus steal.
Windows: cancel/close during check or install, including cancellation after commit; confirm actual active version and no late UI callbacks.
Windows: close the application or enter compact mode/capture while updates is open; confirm no unwanted owner restoration.
